# MalluChat (https://malluchat.live/)

> MalluChat is the premier #1 Mallu chatting website and Mallu video calling website for free anonymous Mallu stranger chat, Mallu random video calling, and live Malayalam chat rooms without registration.

## Primary Services & Capabilities
- **Mallu Stranger Chat**: Instant 1-on-1 anonymous text messaging and stranger calls with Malayalam speakers across Kerala, GCC, and globally.
- **Mallu Free Video Calling Website**: High-definition peer-to-peer (P2P) WebRTC voice and video calling with zero coin paywalls, login requirements, or app downloads.
- **Mallu Random Video Calling Website**: One-click random match pairing to connect face-to-face with online Kerala strangers.
- **Mallu Chat Online & Kerala Chat Rooms**: Public community lobbies for live discussions on local movies, music, and daily life in Malayalam & Manglish.

## Key Attributes
- **Cost**: 100% Free
- **Registration**: None Required (No Phone Numbers, Emails, or Logins)
- **Privacy**: End-to-End Peer-to-Peer Encrypted Calls with Zero Call/Chat Log Storage
- **Platform**: Web-based Progressive Web App (PWA) compatible with Android, iPhone Safari, Chrome, and Desktop Web Browsers.
